info.title: AlianHub API
info.description: Paths, methods, auth and tags only. The full reference is docs/API.md. Generated by npm run api:doc.

tags.name: Identity
tags.description: Who a token is, and what that person may do.

tags.name: Read-only token API
tags.description: Three reads under `/api/public-v1` that accept an API token and nothing else. They are the simplest way to list projects and tasks. Every read is narrowed to what the token's person can open in the web app, and a token limited to projects reads only those.

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: Creating a task and changing one. Both routes take the bodies the web app sends, so their field names follow the stored task. To read tasks, use [Everything](#everything) or the [Read-only token API](#read-only-token-api).

tags.name: Everything
tags.description: One list of tasks across every project the caller can read, with filters, grouping, sorting and a cursor, and the caller's saved views of that list.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Duplicating a project. To list projects, use `GET /api/public-v1/projects`.

tags.name: Pages
tags.description: Docs and wiki pages, and their version history. A page belongs to a project or to the workspace. A private page is its author's alone; any other page is open to whoever can see its project. A page the caller cannot see answers the same as one that does not exist.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Read-only views of the workspace's AI agents: who they are, what they are running and what they have proposed. Runs and proposals are narrowed to the projects and tasks the caller can read.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Managing the webhooks described under [Webhook deliveries](#webhook-deliveries) above. A webhook belongs to the person who created it: nobody else can list, change or delete it, or read its delivery log.
